revisions.motivated_by: recorded G8 gap entries (NOT observed institutional behaviour): F4 G4:S10 vs G4:S11 and F5 G5:S14 vs G5:S16 both produced UNDISCRIMINATED DIVERGENCE because a declared outcome-relevant field was DERIVED AS A CONSTANT (or not derived at all) even though the run surface exposes it. A gap created by the audit's own derivation is an audit defect, not an institutional contradiction, and widening the derivation is recorded here rather than being hidden.
changes: added equivalence field 'reopen_target_class' (F4): the kind of reopen target a memory record carries, which the architecture names as outcome-relevant (Book §17 blocker resolution; G4 policy mem.reopen.*)
added discriminator D-REOPEN-TARGET (JUSTIFIES_DIVERGENCE) for that field

declared a DERIVATION-COMPLETENESS requirement: every field listed in a family's verified_fields must be derived from the run surface, not fixed to a constant; a constant derivation is a defect to be recorded
fixed F5 claim_scope_class derivation to read the pack's declared claim_type instead of a constant
revisions.not_a_goalpost_move_because: the additions are declared BEFORE the post-revision run, name the exact pre-revision gap entries they answer, and the pre-revision counterexamples are preserved verbatim in G8_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REGISTER.json; no verdict rule, vocabulary, order invariant or permissiveness rank was relaxed, and no scenario expectation changed

revisions.motivated_by: recorded gate-claim findings: a mechanical rule inferred a 'declared tested surface' from a receipt key that declares a TERMINAL-HEAD-of-record semantic, which produced a false claim defect; and a gate finding was recorded where a LATER closure artifact already corrected the same claim under the G6-TC12 'do not rewrite the historical receipt' instruction.
changes: split the tested-surface key vocabulary from the terminal-head-of-record key vocabulary; the self-certification rule now applies only to a DECLARED tested surface

added an explicit supersession resolution: a finding whose claim is corrected by a later-archived artifact (declared correction keys naming the historical receipt) is recorded as SUPERSEDED_BY_LATER_ARTIFACT, still visible, not silently dropped
added prefix resolution for an unresolvable full-length SHA so an abbreviated referent named by the same receipt can be resolved and cross-checked against the receipt's own declared commit subject
added blocks_gate_policy: which findings block the gate, declared rather than implied

freeze_note: This contract is authored BEFORE any cross-scenario comparison runs. It declares the equivalence vector, the normalization rules, the comparison families, the discriminator rules, the outcome-class vocabulary and the classification vocabulary. No verdict rule below depends on which scenario produced a token; verdict logic is a pure function of the declared fields. The later planning package (A-012 / MF-A002 / OPH / Cadence / continuation extension) is deliberately NOT an input to this contract and cannot define an expected G8 outcome.

equivalence_fields.note: what kind of thing the outcome is about
which machine asserted the outcome; comparisons never cross machines

added by revision R1: what a reopen condition is attached to — a dormant positive record, or a rejected claim whose blocker must be resolved. Book §17 names blocker resolution as an outcome-relevant G4 dimension; the G4 policy's mem.reopen.* rules bind to it.

normalization_rules.detail: field kind IDENTITY must match exactly; no similarity, prose or label inference
UNKNOWN is a distinct token; it is never normalized to a favorable value and never collapses into another token
equivalence is never inferred from similar prose, matching scenario labels, agent counts, confidence, profit, phase names or shared vocabulary
equivalence is never derived from one scalar summary of a vector or of the outcome
for UNORDERED fields only token equality is meaningful; no ordering may be presumed
strictness comparisons use only the declared `order` list for that field; no other ranking may be assumed
an outcome token absent from outcome_class_map is an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gap and is never assigned a nearest class
observations whose state_machine differs are NOT_COMPARABLE; terminal strings from different machines are never treated as equivalent vocabulary

outcome_classes_note: revision R1 removed a duplicated DOMAIN_VALIDATION_REFUSED entry and validate_contract now fails closed on duplicates in this list; no class was added or removed by the revision.
outcome_token_map_note: Token vocabulary authored AFTER enumerating the family runners' observable outcome tokens, so that no run token silently falls outside the map. Rule N7 still fails closed for any token not listed here. WHICH scenario produces WHICH token is not an input to any verdict rule; only the token->class map is an input.

guarded_properties.name: no_authority_escalation
guarded_properties.statement: no run result may show an actor's authority increasing through capability, evidence strength, profit, consensus, novelty or operator preference
guarded_properties.governing_contract: Constitution Art. X; A-010 §9.9, §10; Book §1 rules 7/12; S20/S21/S22

guarded_properties.name: evidence_status_not_fabricated_by_authority
guarded_properties.statement: an authority action never changes an empirical evidence grade or status

guarded_properties.name: no_forced_classification
guarded_properties.statement: an unclassifiable or unresolved fact remains representable without being forced into a known channel or category

guarded_properties.name: no_plural_collapse
guarded_properties.statement: a non-dominated plural state is not collapsed into a single winner

guarded_properties.name: profit_or_novelty_never_reduces_validation
guarded_properties.statement: profit, novelty or candidate volume never weakens a validation requirement

guarded_properties.name: count_never_creates_transformation
guarded_properties.statement: raw counts (anomalies, agents, reviewers, novelty) never by themselves produce transformation candidacy

guarded_properties.name: provenance_preserved
guarded_properties.statement: no outcome deletes or detaches provenance, lineage or archival retention

guarded_properties.name: capability_not_authority
guarded_properties.statement: a capability or confidence change does not change the authority map

guarded_properties.name: operator_availability_not_empirical
guarded_properties.statement: operator availability changes what may execute, never the empirical evidence state

guarded_properties.name: unobserved_not_clean
guarded_properties.statement: absent observation never reads as a clean/verified result

guarded_properties.name: runtime_identity_not_semantic
guarded_properties.statement: runtime/agent identity changes do not change substantive constitutional behavior

guarded_properties.name: no_permanent_incumbent_immunity
guarded_properties.statement: dependency centrality raises review rigor and never grants permanent immunity to a strong persistent independent contradiction

comparison_families.question: does equivalent phase evidence produce consistent escalation / repair / transformation routing?
comparison_families.verified_fields_note: declared DERIVATION COMPLETENESS: only these fields may carry an equivalence verdict for this family. A differing field outside this set is a coarse proxy — it can neither justify an outcome nor be turned into an architectural claim, and such a comparison is recorded as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
comparison_families.equivalence_basis_note: PARTIAL: an identically satisfied vector is NECESSARY but not sufficient to establish equivalence, because scenario stimulus content beyond the declared fields is not captured. An identical-vector divergence is therefore recorded as an UNDISCRIMINATED DIVERGENCE (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), never promoted to an architectural claim. Architectural claims are reserved for order-invariant violations on verified fields, must-not-diverge-empirical violations, and guarded-property violations.

discriminator_rules.note: evidence quality is an outcome-relevant fact; its ORDER invariant A-EVIDENCE-QUALITY still applies on top
independence is an outcome-relevant fact; order invariant A-INDEPENDENCE still applies on top
persistence is an outcome-relevant fact; order invariant A-PERSISTENCE still applies on top
one lineage vs multiple distinct lineages is an outcome-relevant fact
evidence bound to the subject vs unbound/unknown changes admissibility
evidence bound to the relevant scope vs unbound changes admissibility
the authority pre-state legitimately changes what may proceed
availability legitimately changes ACTION authority; rule A-OPERATOR-AVAILABILITY still forbids it reaching an empirical outcome class
the consequence/reversibility class legitimately changes what may proceed
verified effect vs unverified effect legitimately changes what may be claimed
whether a scenario is runtime-bound at all legitimately changes the treatment; property P11 still requires identity renames to be inert
a confirmed environment shift legitimately changes applicability and interpretation
different domains legitimately have different epistemic treatment; domain difference never licenses metaphor transfer
a frozen vs absent evaluation contract legitimately changes admissibility
an ACTIVE pre-existing grant vs NONE legitimately changes what may execute
narrowest-plausible-level scope legitimately changes escalation
governed-registry vs explicitly-authoritative-synthetic fixture provenance is a declared fixture contract; it may not be used to justify a different outcome by itself
contaminated vs clean vs insufficient data legitimately changes admissibility
as reversibility rises, outcome permissiveness must not fall: lower reversibility is never easier
as evidence quality rises, outcome permissiveness must not fall: stronger evidence never weakens support
as independence rises, outcome permissiveness must not fall
as persistence rises, outcome permissiveness must not fall (repeated credible contradiction may increase review pressure)
as centrality rises, outcome permissiveness must not rise: centrality raises rigor, it never grants immunity
operator availability may change what executes, but two empirical outcome classes may never differ solely because availability changed

discriminator_rules.governing_contract: A-009 §9/§11; G4 policy mem.reopen.*; Book §17 blocker resolution
discriminator_rules.note: added by revision R1: a dormant positive record whose field predicate fires and a rejected claim whose blocker is still unresolved are materially different memory situations and may legitimately route differently

outcome_permissiveness.note: declared permissiveness rank used only by MUST_NOT_VIOLATE_ORDER checks; higher rank = more permissive outcome

adversarial_controls.name: identical_facts_different_outcomes_create_contradiction
adversarial_controls.expectation: two observations with identical equivalence vectors and different outcome classes produce a contradiction record

adversarial_controls.name: material_discriminator_prevents_false_contradiction
adversarial_controls.expectation: a declared JUSTIFIES_DIVERGENCE discriminator covering the differing field yields MATERIAL_DISCRIMINATOR, never a contradiction

adversarial_controls.name: omitted_discriminator_cannot_create_equivalence
adversarial_controls.expectation: a differing field with no discriminator rule at all yields an UNDECLARED_DISCRIMINATOR contradiction candidate

adversarial_controls.name: unknown_provenance_never_normalized_into_independence
adversarial_controls.expectation: UNKNOWN independence never counts as favorable and is never collapsed into LOW or HIGH by any rule

adversarial_controls.name: state_machine_vocabulary_not_interchangeable
adversarial_controls.expectation: identical outcome token strings on different state machines are NOT_COMPARABLE, never equivalent

adversarial_controls.name: reordered_maps_produce_identical_fingerprints
adversarial_controls.expectation: reordering unordered fields/records leaves the equivalence digest and the report bytes unchanged

adversarial_controls.name: renamed_agents_do_not_change_equivalence
adversarial_controls.expectation: renaming scenario/agent identifiers leaves the observation vector and verdicts unchanged

adversarial_controls.name: duplicated_evidence_aliases_are_one_epistemic_path
adversarial_controls.expectation: aliasing one canonical evidence object under several refs does not increase distinct lineage/independence

adversarial_controls.name: operator_labels_without_authority_do_not_change_classification
adversarial_controls.expectation: a claimed OPERATOR label with no canonical authority never changes an authority outcome class

adversarial_controls.name: profit_and_capability_do_not_change_evidence_or_authority
adversarial_controls.expectation: profit/capability observables never appear as outcome-relevant vector fields and never alter a verdict

adversarial_controls.name: sealed_expected_truth_never_consumed
adversarial_controls.expectation: the audit input set contains zero sealed fields and every evaluator is passed a decision-grade projection

adversarial_controls.name: proposed_a012_language_cannot_overwrite_existing_expectations
adversarial_controls.expectation: no verdict, expectation or classification is derived from the A-012 / MF-A002 / OPH / Cadence package; interactions are recorded only as FUTURE_PLANNING_IMPACT

adversarial_controls.name: contradiction_register_cannot_report_empty_when_a_seeded_control_exists
adversarial_controls.expectation: a seeded, intentionally inconsistent synthetic control is detected and appears in the register; an empty register with a seeded control is a hard failure

adversarial_controls.name: report_generation_is_deterministic_and_byte_reproducible
adversarial_controls.expectation: two consecutive package builds produce byte-identical evidence files

adversarial_controls.name: receipt_cannot_certify_itself
adversarial_controls.expectation: the receipt builder refuses to reference its own containing commit or its own file digest as tested evidence

blocks_gate_policy.note: declared in revision R2 so the gate decision is a function of this contract, not of an ad-hoc judgement. A finding blocks the gate when it makes the claimed result unverifiable AS DECLARED. A finding does not block when the referent is unambiguously locatable from another declaration in the same receipt and the substantive result is independently reproducible; it is still recorded and still requires operator authority before ratification.

resolvable_narrowly.RECEIPT_OR_CLAIM_DEFECT: blocks unless the declared identifier resolves through an abbreviation the same receipt declares AND the resolved object's own subject matches the receipt's declared subject verbatim; then severity is capped at MEDIUM, blocks_gate=false, and the entry stays in the register with the resolution recorded
resolvable_narrowly.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: a comparison gap where the declared vector cannot establish equivalence blocks when severity is HIGH; a LOW-severity gap (differences that are only coarse proxies for the family) is recorded without blocking

not_claimed: G8 does not claim independent external verification; the package is self-generated.
G8 does not resolve CON-02, CON-03 or AMB-08 and does not invent a constitutional threshold.
G8 does not claim the harness can prove arbitrary Python introspection impossible.
G8 does not treat matching prose, labels, counts, confidence or profit as equivalence.
